notes.title: 1.0.1 - Minor Changes and Fixes
notes.content:
- Remade: Apex Summit ski run, (It got harder) felt far to easy in comparison to the other ski runs :o
- Fixed: Various networking bug fixes
- Added: [b]Accessibility Cursor Mode[/b] under Control Settings. As requested by a Steam User.
- Added: Ability to play using mouse clicks as keyboard keys. [b]Left Click[/b] acts as [A] key, [b]Right Click[/b] acts as [D] key. Pressing both mouse buttons acts as the [Space] key.
